raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #44070. On a PD prefill server with HiCache, a request re-matched after another request's load-back in the same batch build counts the not-yet-loaded pages as device prefix. `maybe_send_cached_prefix_chunk` then hands those pages to the KV transfer before the H2D copy writes them, so decode silently gets stale KV.

## Modifications

- `Scheduler.run_batch`: if this batch's build submitted a load-back (`batch.hicache_consumer_index >= 0`), skip the early send for its requests. The post-forward send covers the range after the forward has waited for every load layer.
- `maybe_send_cached_prefix_chunk`: new `allow_send` argument. It returns before sending, after the staging snapshot.
- Unit test: no early send when the batch started a load-back; the early send still happens when it didn't.

## Accuracy Tests

The #44070 repro (1P1D, NIXL, HiCache `write_back`, `--disaggregation-enable-kv-checksum` on both roles) on the 2026-10-13 SGLang nightly image, with only this PR's two source files overlaid. The image's copies of those files are identical to this PR's base.

| `--hicache-io-backend` | Trials | KV checksum mismatches, before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| `direct` | 30 | 29 | **0** |
| `kernel` | 30 | not run | **0** |

With the fix, both concurrent requests' greedy outputs match a fresh run (30/30 each). Batches without a load-back still early-send (every device-hit request did).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Batches whose build starts a load-back lose the early-send overlap: their KV goes out after the forward. In the repro this was about 54 ms later for a 100K-token prefix. Other batches are unchanged.

Follow-up: keep the overlap by handing the load's completion event to the sender and waiting on it before the read. That needs every connector to honor a wait event; see #43299 for NIXL.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -1414,7 +1414,9 @@ def process_prefill_chunk(
             if last_batch.batch_size() < last_bs:
                 running_batch.batch_is_full = False
 
-    def maybe_send_cached_prefix_chunk(self: Scheduler, req: Req) -> None:
+    def maybe_send_cached_prefix_chunk(
+        self: Scheduler, req: Req, allow_send: bool = True
+    ) -> None:
         if not envs.SGLANG_DISAGG_PREFILL_EARLY_SEND_CACHED_PREFIX.get():
             return
 
@@ -1424,7 +1426,9 @@ def maybe_send_cached_prefix_chunk(self: Scheduler, req: Req) -> None:
         if self.enable_staging and req.early_send_prefix_end is None:
             req.early_send_prefix_end = max(0, req.prefix_len - req.host_hit_length)
 
-        if req.pending_bootstrap:
+        # allow_send=False: a HiCache load-back from this build may still be writing
+        # pages matched as device prefix; the post-forward send covers them (#44070).
+        if req.pending_bootstrap or not allow_send:
             return
 
         # Device-resident prefix only; page-aligned so start_send_idx stays exact.

@@ -4583,8 +4583,11 @@ def run_batch(
 
         # PD prefill: early-send cached prefix KV, overlapping the suffix forward.
         if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
+            # A load-back submitted in this build may still be writing pages that a
+            # later request matched as device prefix; don't early-send them (#44070).
+            load_pending = batch.hicache_consumer_index >= 0
             for req in batch.reqs:
-                self.maybe_send_cached_prefix_chunk(req)
+                self.maybe_send_cached_prefix_chunk(req, allow_send=not load_pending)
 
         # Run forward
         if self.is_generation:

@@ -1425,5 +1425,65 @@ def test_ranks_agree_on_fifo_completion_and_copy_submission(self):
                         process.join(timeout=5)
 
 
+class _ForwardLaunched(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+class _EarlySendScheduler(SchedulerDisaggregationPrefillMixin):
+    """Just enough Scheduler state for run_batch to reach the forward launch."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.scheduler_stage_metrics = None
+        self.metrics_reporter = SimpleNamespace(record_scheduler_active=Mock())
+        self.forward_ct = 0
+        self._sched_idled = False
+        self.processed_tokens_counter = 0
+        self.scripted_scheduler_hook = None
+        self.profiler_manager = SimpleNamespace(_profile_batch_predicate=Mock())
+        self.forward_sleep_time = None
+        self.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+        self.enable_staging = False
+        self.enable_overlap = False
+        self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator = SimpleNamespace(page_size=64)
+        self.send_kv_chunk = Mock()
+
+    @property
+    def is_generation(self):
+        raise _ForwardLaunched
+
+
+class TestCachedPrefixEarlySend(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_batch_that_starts_a_hicache_load_back_does_not_early_send(self):
+        """A request can match pages whose HiCache load-back was submitted in the same
+        build; early-sending them would read KV the H2D has not written yet (#44070)."""
+        for consumer_index, expect_send in ((-1, True), (0, False)):
+            scheduler = _EarlySendScheduler()
+            req = SimpleNamespace(
+                prefix_len=128,
+                host_hit_length=0,
+                start_send_idx=0,
+                pending_bootstrap=False,
+                early_send_prefix_end=None,
+            )
+            batch = SimpleNamespace(
+                reqs=[req],
+                hicache_consumer_index=consumer_index,
+                extend_num_tokens=32,
+                forward_mode=SimpleNamespace(
+                    is_split_prefill=lambda: False, is_prebuilt=lambda: False
+                ),
+            )
+            with self.subTest(consumer_index=consumer_index):
+                with envs.SGLANG_DISAGG_PREFILL_EARLY_SEND_CACHED_PREFIX.override(True):
+                    with self.assertRaises(_ForwardLaunched):
+                        Scheduler.run_batch(scheduler, batch)
+                if expect_send:
+                    scheduler.send_kv_chunk.assert_called_once_with(
+                        req, last_chunk=False, end_idx=128
+                    )
+                else:
+                    scheduler.send_kv_chunk.assert_not_called()
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
